items.title: Father Al Lewis Interview, 1972-02-21
items.q: And this Fourier, they call him Beansley, they used to have all that gambling, all that bunch. They were the judges back then

ctx.x: And first, that was 1937. And you had 10,000 people there? 10,000 people. I won the swing contest up the city. Well the judges, George McDermott used to have a place, he died, he got killed in a place of establishment. And this Fourier, they call him Beansley, they used to have all that gambling, all that bunch. They were the judges back then, some of the judges, and the priests included, you know, back then. The priests in Beansley, that was a good combination. No, the priests had charge of the, you know, trying…
Where did they put all the people? Was it in a big, a lot of them?
